deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 for Fall 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: Start term Application deadline Fall term December 15

gre_subject.value: The program page does not mention the GRE.

supervisor.value: No need to contact a supervisor before applying; admitted students are assigned one by the graduate committee.
supervisor.quote: Supervisor approval not required to apply | Although you do not need to find or contact a potential supervisor before applying | If you are admitted, a supervisor will be assigned based on both faculty research needs and the interests you outline in your application

funding.value: Most graduate students are funded, normally by a Graduate Teaching Fellowship of at least CAD 25,000/year for PhD; all eligible applicants are considered automatically, but funding is not guaranteed.
funding.quote: We strive to offer financial support to the majority of our graduate students in eligible programs. | Financial support for graduate students is normally offered in the form of Graduate Teaching Fellowships (at least $21,000 CAD for M.Sc. and $25,000 CAD for Ph.D.). The department automatically considers all eligible applicants for this funding.

entry_route.value: A master's degree is required; bachelor's-only applicants cannot be admitted directly to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: under no circumstances may a prospective student holding a bachelor's degree be admitted directly into a Ph.D. program
